Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Suresh - 31 years, son
Look: white kurta-pyjama
2. Anjali - 60 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Kavita - 28 years, daughter
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The bathroom - a tap, a bucket, a mirror
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The bathroom - Day

[Suresh stands in the bathroom. Kavita stands near him.]

Suresh: "Let's do something fun today."

[Suresh shaves in front of the mirror.]

Kavita: "And then?"

Scene 2: The road - Day

Anjali: "What a nice place."

[Suresh rides the scooter with Mother sitting behind him.]

Suresh: "Show me too!"

[Suresh takes Mother to the market on his motorbike, she sits behind him.]

Suresh: "That was such a fun day!"
